security_audit.summary: Seventy-three detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, or benign style text. The two confirmed findings are the runtime installer download and its critical direct pipe into sh; no prompt injection or additional intent-level threat was found.

remediation.issue: The bootstrap command executes a mutable remote installer directly from the network.
remediation.suggestion: Use a pinned release artifact, publish its checksum, verify it before execution, and require explicit user confirmation before installation.

content.value_statement: Producing a consistent narrated explainer requires coordinated scripting, audio, visuals, and assembly. This skill manages the Higgsfield workflow from style selection through final video.
actual_capabilities: Builds one-to-ten-minute explainers from fixed ten-second blocks.
Lists live style presets or creates one style key from references.
Writes matched narration and visual prompts for every block.
Generates one Seed Audio take and Gemini Omni clip per block.
Supports horizontal or vertical output, mascots or faceless scenes, and optional burned subtitles.
Assembles ordered audio-video pairs into one final MP4.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI, an authenticated account, and sufficient service credits.
Produces non-photoreal explainers only; it excludes ads, talking heads, podcasts, and finished-video editing.
Supports whole-minute durations from one to ten minutes.
Depends on live Higgsfield models, presets, voices, and remote job availability.

use_cases.title: Teach a Complex Topic
use_cases.description: Convert verified subject material into a structured animated lesson with synchronized narration and visuals.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Source Material
use_cases.description: Transform a document or research brief into a concise branded explainer for online audiences.

use_cases.title: Animate a Personal Story
use_cases.description: Present supplied story details through a consistent mascot or faceless illustrated sequence without inventing facts.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-minute non-photoreal explainer about [topic]. Ask me to choose style, voice, aspect, character mode, and subtitles before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short topic explainer

prompt_templates.title: Use Source Material
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [document or notes] into a [duration]-minute animated explainer in [language]. Verify factual claims, preserve source meaning, and include sources.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Vertical Explainer
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-minute vertical faceless explainer for [audience] about [topic]. Use [style], [voice], and [subtitle font], with one clear action per block.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain a Mascot Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a [duration]-minute mascot explainer using [reference images] only as style donors. Maintain [palette], [tone], [language], and strict character consistency across every block.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced branded production with visual references

output_examples.input: Create a one-minute monochrome faceless explainer about how solar panels generate electricity.
output_examples.output: A 60-second horizontal MP4 with six synchronized blocks, monochrome illustrated scenes, one narrator, and cited factual sources.

output_examples.input: Turn my career-change story into a two-minute vertical mascot video with subtitles.
output_examples.output: A 120-second vertical MP4 with twelve matched narration and animation blocks, a consistent mascot, and burned subtitles.

output_examples.input: Explain the attached research brief in Spanish using a hand-painted storybook style.
output_examples.output: A source-grounded illustrated MP4 with Spanish narration, English generation prompts, consistent storybook visuals, and a source list.

best_practices: Provide authoritative source documents or links for factual topics.
Choose one clear visual style and one narrator before generation begins.
Review duration, aspect, character mode, subtitle cost, and voice selection before approving generation.
anti_patterns: Do not request photorealistic films, advertisements, talking heads, podcasts, or finished-video edits.
Do not mix visual styles or narrators across blocks.
Do not use unverified facts or expect the skill to invent personal story details.

faq.question: What do I need before starting?
faq.answer: You need the Higgsfield CLI, an authenticated Higgsfield account, and enough credits for every generation job.

faq.question: Can it create photorealistic video?
faq.answer: No. The workflow enforces illustrated, non-photoreal visuals and excludes live-action production.

faq.question: Which durations are supported?
faq.answer: Videos can be one to ten whole minutes, divided into fixed ten-second blocks.

faq.question: Can narration use another language?
faq.answer: Yes. Narration can use the selected language, while image and video generation prompts remain in English.

faq.question: Can I provide style references?
faq.answer: Yes. Reference images guide rendering style and color grading without copying their people, text, logos, or objects.

faq.question: Are subtitles available?
faq.answer: Yes. Burned subtitles are optional, use one supported font, and add a per-block credit charge.
